businessRules.statement: Every feeder MUST originate at a substation node (nodeType='substation').
Service-point voltageClass MUST be ≤ originating substation voltageClass (no step-up downstream).
Per service point, kwhImport / kwhExport readings MUST be non-decreasing in time. Negative deltas indicate meter rollover or fault.
outage.class derived from customersAffected + durationMin: ≥50k → systemic; ≥5k OR ≥240min → regional; ≥100 → local; else isolated. class∈{systemic,regional} → regulator audit.
Outage records are append-only. Restoration is recorded by setting restored_at via reportOutage with prior outageDid as supersedes.
